It defines an inner handler to generate a core schema from the source type or its properties, applying any JSON schema functions extracted from the annotations. For each annotation, it wraps the inner schema generation logic, allowing for nested transformations. Finally, it applies custom serialization using JSON encoders and returns the fully processed schema.
